note: Canonical Birdy inventory. Single source of truth for the offline Python pipeline (corpus rendering, galaxy) and the browser syrinx engine. Contours are [timeFraction, Hz]. Functions marked confidence=experimental are backed by playback experiments; documented = described in the literature; inferred = plausible but not experimentally established.  Extended with syllable types fitted to field recordings: their ids start with `L`, they carry the cosine between their resynthesis and the audio they came from, and none of them has a documented function.

refs.suzuki2016: Suzuki TN, Wheatcroft D, Griesser M (2016) Experimental evidence for compositional syntax in bird calls. Nature Communications 7:10986.
refs.suzuki2014: Suzuki TN (2014) Communication about predator type by a bird using discrete, graded and combinatorial variation in alarm calls. Animal Behaviour 87:59-65.
refs.freeberg2003: Freeberg TM, Lucas JR (2002/2003) Receivers respond differently to chick-a-dee calls varying in note composition. Animal Behaviour.
refs.griesser2008: Griesser M (2008) Referential calls signal predator behavior in a group-living bird species. Current Biology 18:69-73.
refs.okanoya2004: Okanoya K (2004) The Bengalese finch: a window on the behavioral neurobiology of birdsong syntax. Ann NY Acad Sci 1016:724-735.
refs.elie2018: Elie JE, Theunissen FE (2018) Zebra finches identify individuals using vocal signatures unique to each call type. Nature Communications 9:4026.
refs.hultsch1989: Hultsch H, Todt D (1989) Memorization and reproduction of song packages in nightingales. Bioacoustics 1:197-212.
refs.galeotti1991: Galeotti P, Pavan G (1991) Individual recognition of male Tawny owls (Strix aluco) using spectrograms of their territorial calls. Ethology Ecology & Evolution 3:113-126.
refs.amador2013: Amador A, Perl YS, Mindlin GB, Margoliash D (2013) Elemental gesture dynamics are encoded by song premotor cortical neurons. Nature 495:59-64.
refs.amador2021: Amador A, Mindlin GB (2021) Low dimensional dynamics in birdsong production. Frontiers in Neuroscience 15.
refs.beckers2003: Beckers GJL, Suthers RA, ten Cate C (2003) Pure-tone birdsong by resonance filtering of harmonic overtones. PNAS 100:7372-7376.
refs.rutz2023: Rutz C et al. (2023) Using machine learning to decode animal communication. Science 381:152-155.

species.summary: Strongest evidence for word-order rules in birds: ABC = scan for danger, D = approach, ABC-D is a compound with a distinct behavioural response; the reversed order D-ABC elicits nothing.

syllables.label: A note
syllables.function: component of the ABC alarm cluster (snake/predator vigilance)

syllables.label: B note
syllables.function: component of the ABC alarm cluster

syllables.label: C note
syllables.function: component of the ABC alarm cluster

songs.label: ABC
songs.gloss: scan for danger
songs.function: receivers scan horizontally for a predator

songs.label: D
songs.gloss: come here

songs.label: ABC-D
songs.gloss: scan for danger, then come here
songs.function: compound message; elicits both responses, more than the sum of its parts

songs.label: D-ABC (reversed)
songs.gloss: ungrammatical
songs.function: artificially reversed order; in playback experiments it elicits neither response

songs.label: tsu-pi tsu-pi
songs.gloss: this is my territory

songs.gloss: a phrase in this bird's measured syntax

species.summary: chick-a-dee call: four note types in strict A-B-C-D order; the number of D notes scales with threat, and note composition changes receiver behaviour.

species.summary: Alarm calls encode what the predator is doing (perched, searching, attacking), and each elicits a different escape response.
